noticeType.title: Notice type
noticeType.description: Which GOJEP register to pull from. 'Opened bid details' is GOJEP's combined feed of currently-open and historical calls for tenders (title, reference number, procuring entity, description, submission deadline, procurement method, status, award date). 'Contract award notices' lists already-awarded contracts, each with a downloadable Contract Award Notice PDF.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of records to fetch (10 per page upstream). The 'opened' register has roughly 80,000 records and 'awarded' roughly 13,000 at last check, so this caps how deep the run pages into that history.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: Column to sort by. Leave blank to use the register's own default order. Options differ by notice type -- when 'Notice type' is 'awarded', only 'procuringEntity', 'title', 'contractAmount', and 'datePublished' apply (others are ignored).

sortOrder.title: Sort order
sortOrder.description: Only applies when 'Sort by' is set.

includeBidders.title: Include bidder list (opened bids only)
includeBidders.description: For each 'opened' record, additionally fetch its public bidder/supplier list (name, internal bid id, financial value when disclosed) via one extra request per record. Slower for large runs -- leave off unless you need this detail. Ignored when 'Notice type' is 'awarded'.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent requests
maxConcurrency.description: How many pages (or bidder-list lookups) to fetch in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default.
